How it works

1

Pick your game & pack

How selling works

Buyers pick a game and pack, tap Place order, and WhatsApp opens with the full order — game, pack, price and game ID — already written. You reply with your UPI ID, confirm the payment, deliver the top-up to their ID, and mark the order done. Buyers can optionally log in (email or Google) so their name and email ride along with the order — a game password is never asked, ever.

Homepage banner

The big banner at the top of the store. Pick any game artwork already in the store — or upload your own image — and edit the headline, text and button.

Upload your own banner image: it is resized in your browser, applied to the banner right away, and saved with the store data so every visitor sees it.

Trending deals (highlights)

The three highlight cards under Popular Games. Each card links to a game and shows that game's first pack price. Games ticked “Trending” in the Games tab lead the Popular Games row.

Games & packs editor

Add, edit or delete games and their packs — names, prices, MRP, bonus text, tags, cover artwork and the Zone ID requirement. Changes update the store grid, Popular row and order totals.

FAQ editor

Questions shown in the Questions section on the homepage.

Coupons

Coupons are saved on the store backend. Signed-in buyers type a code in the top-up panel and the discount comes off the total when their order is placed. Toggle a coupon off to stop it without deleting it.

SEO

What search engines and link previews show for this store. The store name also appears in the header, footer and order messages.

Orders

Real orders from the store backend. Move each order through its status, retry Busan delivery on paid orders, and approve wallet top-up requests — approving credits the buyer's wallet instantly.

Users

Every registered account on the store backend, with real order counts. Turn on Reseller to give a user reseller prices — the backend charges them the reseller price set on each pack (Games tab). There is no delete option here.

Bulk prices

Raise or lower every pack price in one go — e.g. −10 during a sale, or +5 when costs go up. MRP moves by the same percentage so the discount shown stays honest. Prices round to the nearest rupee and never drop below ₹1.
